title: Archive through April 6, 2004 - Anonymous (Tuesday, March 30, 2004 - 10:06 pm)

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Fell/tipped down a 'black plastic hole' (drain) and 'fell through' before landing in bright sunlit.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Described being 'tipped down' a hole and falling through it.

arrival.other_being_detail: Hospital staff 'turned into little silver entities with round featureless heads' carrying 'silver spheres' (dead patients). Also a 'bearded face' known as 'enemy' and 'diabolical'. A 'huge hand' came down from above with a 'golden sheet'.

environment.environment_other_detail: Hospital(s), tower block, huge tank in hospital grounds with drain/black hole; later 'bright sunlit'; later 'St. Paul's cathedral'; later 'rocks' with 'gates separating two towers' and 'tiles arranged in a circle'.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Emergency heart surgery (quadruple bypass) after heart attacks; then prolonged unconsciousness under full life support.

person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: States 'contrary to all my previous beliefs' when considering possibility of a personal God, implying prior non-theistic stance but not explicitly labeled.
person_demographics.occupation: Communications systems designer/manager; previously physics-qualified researcher; later ran own company.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Predominantly described as vivid dream-like sequences while unconscious; included prayer to God and a 'huge hand' from above placing a 'golden sheet'.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE described; multiple dream episodes with confused order; includes falling through a black hole to sunlit place; later cathedral/rocks/gates/diabolical face; prayer and 'blue tide' and 'huge hand'.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Returned 'to this dream sequence many times' involving rocks/gates/diabolical face and pushing it back with golden fire, becoming weaker each time.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Reports that it became 'very confused, as if several dreams were occurring together.'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Alien/silver-entity hospital staff carrying dead patients as silver spheres; huge tank of 'bits of people'; being tipped down a drain/black plastic hole; daughter as pagan priestess who stabs him; staged cruciform pose in golden bodysuit; diabolical face attacked; 'blue tide' and a huge hand placing a golden sheet behind tiles in a circle; strong emphasis on these being 'dreams' but with a verified ring/watch detail.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “O God help me and if You do I will make an act of contrition.”; “I was tipped down this black plastic hole. I fell through and landed in bright sunlit, to my considerable surprise and relief.”; “as soon as I woke, I was most insistent that my wife answer a question: where was my wedding ring?”
